outcome: Development of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (IHCP)
cohort: The study included 3523 pregnant females from a tertiary care hospital, with 352 suffering from pruritus and 42 diagnosed with IHCP.
finding: Pruritus affected 9.99% of pregnant women, and a significant subset diagnosed with IHCP was consistently associated with elevated serum bile acid levels.
mod_finding: A higher, though not statistically significant, rate of Caesarean section was observed among patients with IHCP.
